description: API Parkings Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Citédia. Citédia rejoint les acteurs fournisseurs de données Open Data de la métropole. La version 1.0 de l’API Parkings permet d’interroger unitairement ou dans leur ensemble les données relatives aux 10 parkings en ouvrage de la ville de Rennes. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are stationnement, api, temps réel. The portal shows 2016-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
